title: Sidecar Tour
text: Our guide Andre was fantastic and it was a great all day excursion. The vantage point from the motorcycle was great! Would definitely do again and strongly recommended.
author: U2288FGjeffb

title: Great family activity to see everything in the summer heat
text: We did the 8 hour tour on a hot August day with our 7 and 9 year old. What a fantastic way to see a lot with kids and also beat the heat. The guys were great, stopping when we needed a break, answered tons of questions, and gave us a great feel for Barcelona. I highly recommend this as a way to tour the city in an efficient way, or get oriented at the start. Great for families too - we felt incredibly safe the whole time.
author: juliey638

title: Great way to see Barcelona!
text: Fun way to explore Barcelona.  So much easier to get the full overview as opposed to walking since it is such a large city.  Our guide Stephan did a great job and was very attentive to detail.  We stopped for lunch and had a great authentic meal with our guide who helped guide us through ordering which is so nice when you are unsure how to read the menu.  We learned a lot.  We enjoyed our day!
author: roxanneh940

title: Great Tour with Johannes!
text: My husband and I had a very fun day with Johannes. Hubby was on the back of the bike and I was in the side car. The down side is that when you stop at a light, the exhaust fumes of the car or bus in front of you are pretty strong. Also, when we visited the cemetery, which was fascinating, the road was very bumpy! I think we could have spent less time in the cemetery and maybe gone to the castle, which we didn't get to do.  Johnnes was friendly and engaging and really know alot about the city. Highly recommend!
author: R5500TUjenniferg

title: Would do this tour over and over
text: I cannot say enough good things about this tour.  We had three days in Barcelona before a cruise and this was the highlight of our vacation.  There is no way we could have seen as much of the city without this tour and Stefan and Oscar were so knowledgeable and so much fun to ride with.  We will tell everyone that is going to Barcelona to use this company.
author: jhstowe71

title: Great way to cover Barcelona in a day!
text: Johannes provided us a very fun and informative day seeing a lot of Barcelona which was perfect as our time in Barcelona was fairly short.  This is a great way to cover a lot of territory quickly.
author: mary165

title: A great Day in Barcelona
text:
We did a full-day tour with Johannes, we had a wonderful day, being able to see everything in Barcelona we needed to see on a tight schedule.
Johannes was very pleasant to deal with, the day just flew past.
We caught a lot of attention throughout the day which made us feel like royalty :)
author: Curiosity771968

title: Extraordinary Tour with Lorenzo
text: Our one day tour on a private van with Lorenzo just made our short trip to Barcelona an unforgettable one. We have included entrance to Sagrada Familia and to Park Guell to our tour and we are truly glad we did. The cava on the top with a full city view was cherry on top! Lorenzo’s energy and knowledge made the tour so special and fun. We did nit understand how 8 hours went by this quick. Definitely a must for every Barcelona trip!
author: p_dilara

title: Lorenzo steers us across the best experience
text: This was our 1st time to Barcelona and our tour guide over-exceeded our expectations!! Lorenzo was absolutely amazing!! We didn’t know the meeting point and he was so gracious and patient with us. He came and picked us up and didn’t skimp on the sites despite our delay. He was knowledgeable, friendly, and a pleasure to spend the day with!! He even left us with suggestions on places to go back and see as well as restaurant recommendations. I’d encourage anyone visiting this beautiful city for the first time to take this tour!! Request Lorenzo!! He’s the best!
author: O4180AJrodneyp

title: Motorcycle sidecar tour of Barcelona
text: This has got to be the best way to see Barcelona!  Juli was my guide/driver and he was amazing!!  He customized the tour to my likes and was extremely knowledgeable. I strongly recommend this tour!
author: 573dougw
